articles.title: President Ilham Aliyev congratulates President of Latvia on occasion of Independence Day
articles.summary: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev has sent a congratulatory letter to Edgars Rinkēvičs, President of the Republic of Latvia.
